question: In the 1892 Indian Councils Act, the British government introduced certain reforms in response to Indian demands. Which of the following was a significant provision of this Act?

options.text: Provision for Indian representation in the Imperial Legislative Council
Granting full self-governance to Indian provinces
Establishment of a separate electorate for Muslims
Introduction of direct elections for legislative councils

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Provision for Indian representation in the Imperial Legislative Council**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Councils Act of 1892** was a crucial step by the British government to address some of the political demands of Indians during the late 19th century.
 
• This Act introduced the **concept of Indian representation** in the legislative councils, although the representation was limited and indirect.
